facts.seated-man: A man in a red hat sits on a wooden chair with arms folded, smiling contentedly.
facts.nine-cups-arc: Behind him, on a long table covered with blue cloth, nine cups stand in a semicircle.
facts.striped-robe: He wears a garment of black stripes on white.
facts.feet-apart: He sits comfortably with his feet apart.

glosses.seated-man: With arms folded, it can also be read as contentment enjoyed alone.
glosses.nine-cups-arc: An abundance stored up behind him.

reversedGloss.excess: Past contentment, into excess such as overeating and overspending.
reversedGloss.internalized: Fine on the outside, but empty inside.
